artboards.title: B · Actionable KPI cards + right rail

annotations.text:
A · Two-lane hub (recommended)
First block on Overview. W1/W2 by AoW + program-level outcomes; W3 = my centers × projects funding SP02, search-first (Alliance alone has ~198 projects): per-center counts, a 3-row slice, Show all.
+ Answers 'where do I report' where users already look; one screen shows both paths.
− Adds ~500px above the dashboard; needs collapse memory.

B · Actionable KPI cards + right rail
Cards 1–2 gain a CTA footer; a sticky rail lists the routes and the W3 projects. AoW rows get an inline Report action.
+ Smallest footprint; Overview keeps its dashboard feel.
− Affordance hidden in stat cards; rail competes with existing 12-col cards on narrower screens.

C · Dedicated Report tab
Renames Reporting → Report; a W1/W2 | W3 switch sits above today's grouped table, W3 pane lists center projects.
+ Clear IA: status (Overview) vs action (Report) vs record (Results).
− Touches routes, guide tutorials and copy; Overview still cannot act on W3.
